resources.string: Looking for a USB UVC camera.
Plug a UVC-compatible webcam into the TV, then select “Check again”.
Allow camera access in the system dialog to show the live preview.
Confirm the USB permission dialog shown by the TV.
USB access was denied. Select “Check again” and allow this device.
Camera access was denied. Enable it in TV Settings → Apps → OpenCamara TV → Permissions.
The USB device was found, but this TV does not expose it as an external camera. Confirm UVC support or update the TV system.
The camera did not provide a supported preview resolution.
Reconnect the camera and try again. If this continues, the TV firmware may not support external camera apps.
The camera opened, but the preview could not be started. Try another USB port or resolution.
Reconnect the USB camera, then check again.
Select Mirror to flip the image · Back to exit
Photo saved to %1$s. It may take a moment to appear in Gallery.
Wait for the camera preview before taking a photo.
Storage permission is required to save photos.
